fg.$description: Text color of a breadcrumb link: brand pink on the black page, 8.37:1, always underlined like every link (BR-01, ADR-0011, ADR-0028).

fgHover.$description: Text color of a breadcrumb link while hovered. Draft: the hover color is not part of ADR-0028. TBD-08: no shade is defined, so it repeats the brand pink (BR-01).

fg.$description: Text color of the current page, the last item: plain bold text, not underlined (ADR-0028). TBD-04: the body text color is not decided; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
Color of the caret between two items. It is decorative and hidden from assistive technology. TBD-05: the neutral scale is not defined; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.

color.$description: Focus ring color of a breadcrumb link (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

width.$description: Focus ring width of a breadcrumb link (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between a breadcrumb link and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of a breadcrumb link (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).
